description:
While buying a health insurance plan, you will ideally have to choose between a Family Floater Health Insurance and an Individual Health Insurance.

The main difference between the two is that in a family floater health insurance, all family members are protected under one plan; .

However,  an individual health insurance plan is dedicated to one person only, wherein the health insurance premium and sum insured is dedicated to one person only.
